items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I got a few pointers from Professor Turo, too. Pinchback Turo. Oh, yeah. Pinchback. Violin player. He was uptown. Oh, yeah. I lost track of him. I don't know when he died.

ctx.x: I was in school and stuff

We started a school there. Mr. Jones, remember Mr. Jones home? He started a school there. Well, that's a long time ago. I was a kid then. I was in school. He had a set up there. He would take music lessons, carpentry work, printing. Oh, he had about four or five different crafts you could take. You could take a couple of them if you want. Well, that's where I started lying right down to Professor Middleton. Remember him? What was his name? You know his first name? Middleton. I never did know other than... What…
